projection.yaw_reason: R-C9-45 cl.1 'from the SOUTH-EAST looking NORTH-WEST'. SE is 45 deg exactly; 45 deg is the only yaw at which both rising walls present equally. The GD runtime's 47 deg is a yaw in referent axes, which carry no compass.

layers.fade: fade_layer_v2_* -- piers and the occluding west-wall bays; NOT in the plate, because a fading prop must have floor painted behind it
layers.overhead: overhead_vault_v2_* and per-chunk _vault.png -- the ceiling layer, scroll > 1, edge-anchored (T3p)
layers.floor_light: floor_light_v2.png and per-chunk _light.png -- greyscale; the vault's banding and the sunset shafts. A PAINTER'S CUE, never geometry

guide_rule: every opening to the OUTSIDE and every un-architected background pixel is flat pure #00ff00
paint_order_rule: row by row, top to bottom, left to right; a chunk is painted after its left and above neighbours (when kept)
